subtitle: 从你的聊天里，读出你没说出口的安排
description: 拾意读取你聊天里的一条消息，认出藏在里面的时间、地点与待办，做成一张等你点头的卡片；你确认后它去执行，并记住你的长期偏好，下次自动调整建议。Agent 干活，人保留控制。
release_notes: 0.3.0 — screen 1 now asks the host's on-device assistant (octos.session.open / octos.turn.start) what the message still leaves out, and prints that answer beside the local rule's. The assistant line renders only when a reply actually arrives: with no assistant, or when a turn fails, the screen falls back to the local rule and never shows an error.
